summary: A web application for Darshit Sheth, a certified financial advisor with 14 years of experience, to promote mutual fund investments through JM Financial for the Indian market. The app will help attract and assist potential investors.
architectural_notes: Target market: Indian investors; content and regulations should reflect Indian financial market context (SEBI, AMC, etc.)
Branding should align with JM Financial identity and Darshit Sheth as advisor

existing_features.title: Create a professional landing/home page that prominently features Darshit Sheth's name, title ('Certified Financial Advisor – Indian Market'), 14 years of experience, and his association with JM Financial. Include a hero section with a strong call-to-action button inviting visitors to 'Start Investing Today' or 'Book a Free Consultation'.

Build a 'Why Invest in Mutual Funds' section explaining the benefits of mutual fund investments tailored to the Indian market (e.g., SIP options, tax-saving ELSS funds, diversification, SEBI regulation, long-term wealth creation). Present benefits as visually distinct cards or icon-driven items.

Create a mutual fund product/category listing section showcasing major fund categories available through JM Financial relevant to the Indian market (e.g., Equity Funds, Debt Funds, Hybrid Funds, ELSS/Tax Saver Funds, SIP Plans). Each category card should show a brief description, key feature tags, and a 'Know More / Invest Now' button.

Build a lead capture / investor inquiry form that collects the investor's full name, email, phone number, city, preferred fund category (dropdown), estimated investment amount range (dropdown), and a short message. On submission, the data is saved to the backend and a success confirmation message is shown to the user.

Create a simple admin/advisor dashboard page (accessible via a dedicated route, no authentication required for initial build) where Darshit Sheth can view a table of all submitted investor leads including their name, contact info, city, fund interest, amount range, and submission date.

Apply a professional, trust-inspiring visual theme across the entire application. Use a color palette evoking financial stability and Indian market warmth — such as deep navy or forest green as primary, with gold/amber accents. Typography should be clean and modern. Layout should feel premium and authoritative, suitable for a certified financial advisor's platform.
Update Darshit Sheth's contact phone number to 9725501285 wherever it appears across the site, including the Footer component and any other components that display contact details.
Update the 'Assets Under Management' stat to '₹10 Crore' in all components where this statistic is displayed, including the HeroSection and AdvisorProfile components.
Update the 'Managing Clients' stat to '150+' in all components where this statistic is displayed, including the HeroSection and AdvisorProfile components.

Why Invest / benefits section explaining advantages of mutual fund investments in India
